How strong thine arm is, mighty God
How strong thine arm is, mighty God,
Who would not fear thy Name!
Jesus, how sweet thy graces are!
Who would not love the Lamb!
Where Watts found it
Watts printed the hymn under Revelation 15:3. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations! REVELATION 15:3 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ REVELATION 15
Then shall our love and joy be full, And feel a warmer flame; And sweeter voices tune the song Of Moses and the Lamb. STANZA VI
